title: ID0377717-DC/SID/AT-[ MP / S4 170003530]-Unable to complete charging
description:
Reported behavior/ issue:  No charging processes were completed at the left-hand charging point CP1 throughout the day. My suspicion is that the charging current is minimized due to the heat, but the charging process is aborted and displayed as completed. Is it due to the heat? What is the cause of this? Why is the charging process not being continued?

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0377717-DC/SID/AT-[ MP / S4 170003530]-Unable to complete charging CRM:01282000536
additional_info.body:
Hi Daniel,
I hope this email finds you well.
We apologize for the delayed response. After analyzing the logs, we have identified that both outlets use RFID for authentication, requiring the scanning of the tag. The backend system accepts the TagID if it is listed in the group. Upon reviewing the logs for that day, there were no issues on the EVSE side. However, we encountered difficulties retrieving the SECC logs due to the charging session's date being very old. In the provided snapshot, you can observe multiple charging sessions were attempted without the tag being scanned, resulting in Error Code: 38, related to Authorization. The charging phase transitions from Unknown to Authorization but reverts to Unknown due to the absence of a scanned tag.
Regarding the charging session that was aborted at 61% EV_SOC, no errors related to EVSE were found. We recommend conducting a charging session with the specific EV on both outlets to determine if there are any issues. Subsequently, we can review the SECC logs if necessary. EV details for your reference.
EVCCID":"0016810efc4e","EVMAC":"00.16.81.0e.fc.4e"
I am waiting for your response.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0377717-DC/SID/AT-[ MP / S4 170003530]-Unable to complete charging CRM:01282000536
additional_info.body:
Hi Shrey,
Thank you for your analysis.
I was on site myself at the time and could see that there were some charging processes that were simply terminated without any action on my part. It is also possible that these were stopped by the EV. It was really hot that day, now we have autumn temperatures.
And coordinating loading tests with the trucks is difficult because the drivers are constantly changing and the trucks are in continuous operation. I have not received any more complaints from the customer either. I think we can close the ticket.
If such an error occurs again, I will open a ticket and refer to this one.
Thanks
BR
Daniel
